help_output:
Pingenerator CLI — Every Pin Generator MCP tool as a typed command, with credit-safe dry runs, preflight pricing and a local spend ledger.

Highlights (not in the official API docs):
  • pin-post   Turn a blog post URL into a scheduled Pinterest pin in one command, previewed for free before any credit is spent.
  • preflight   Price a planned batch in credits and confirm the profile, board and design profile exist before spending anything.
  • pin-products   Turn a connected store's products into a batch of scheduled pins, skipping products already pinned.
  • unpinned-posts   List sitemap posts that have no scheduled pin and no ledgered spend.
  • ledger   See every credit-spending call this CLI executed, with totals by tool and time window.
  • queue-gaps   Find empty and overloaded days in the scheduled-pin queue, per board.
  • credit-runway   Estimate weekly credit burn from active automations and how many days of credit remain.

Agent mode: add --agent to any command for JSON output + non-interactive mode.
Health check: run 'pingenerator-pp-cli doctor' to verify auth and connectivity.
See README.md or the bundled SKILL.md for recipes.

Usage:
  pingenerator-pp-cli [command]

Available Commands:
  agent-context                Emit structured JSON describing this CLI for agents
  auth                         Manage authentication for Pin Generator
  completion                   Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  create-automation            Create a recurring automation that pins from posts or a topic.
  credit-runway                Estimate weekly credit burn from active automations and how many days of credit remain.
  doctor                       Check CLI health
  feedback                     Record feedback about this CLI (local by default; upstream opt-in)
  find-website-posts           Read a site's sitemap to find real blog posts/pages, newest first.
  generate-ai-pin-image        Generate a fully AI, on-brand pin image (unique every time). (12-24 credits; dry run unless --execute)
  generate-and-schedule-ai-pin Generate a fully AI pin and schedule it to Pinterest. (13-25 credits; dry run unless --execute)
  generate-and-schedule-pin    Render a template pin and schedule it to Pinterest. (1 credit; dry run unless --execute)
  generate-pin-image           Render a template pin image and return its hosted URL. (1 credit; dry run unless --execute)
  get-account-status           Account email, credit usage and connected-profile count. Call first to confirm the connection.
  get-automation-batch-status  Follow a running batch: phase, progress and pin count.
  get-post-content             Pull the title, description and images from a post URL.
  help                         Help about any command
  import                       Import data from JSONL file via API create/upsert calls
  learnings                    Inspect or forget the local search_learnings table
  ledger                       See every credit-spending call this CLI executed, with totals by tool and time window.
  list-automations             List automations, their cadence, status and next batch.
  list-boards                  List a connected profile's boards, with IDs for scheduling.
  list-connected-stores        List connected Shopify, Etsy and WooCommerce stores.
  list-design-profiles         List saved AI design profiles.
  list-pinterest-profiles      List Pinterest profiles connected to this account (use username as --pinterest-profile).
  list-scheduled-pins          Review everything queued or scheduled: titles, boards and times.
  list-store-products          Browse a store's products: titles, prices, links and photos.
  list-templates               Browse the built-in pin templates and their styles (free).
  local-data                   Erase the API data this CLI keeps on disk
  mcp                          Send a raw JSON-RPC request to the Pin Generator MCP endpoint.
  pin-post                     Turn a blog post URL into a scheduled Pinterest pin in one command, previewed for free before any credit is spent.
  pin-products                 Turn a connected store's products into a batch of scheduled pins, skipping products already pinned.
  playbook                     Inspect or amend stored CLI playbooks
  preflight                    Price a planned batch in credits and confirm the profile, board and design profile exist before spending anything.
  profile                      Named sets of flags saved for reuse
  queue-gaps                   Find empty and overloaded days in the scheduled-pin queue, per board.
  recall                       Check prior learnings for a query before running discovery (LLM-fired, pre-discovery)
  run-automation-batch         Kick off a fresh batch of pins for an automation. (credits per pin; dry run unless --execute)
  schedule-pin                 Schedule an already-hosted image to Pinterest. (1 credit; dry run unless --execute)
  setup-design-profile         Build a reusable brand design profile from a site, images or description.
  teach                        Record a query -> resource mapping for future recall (LLM-fired, silent)
  teach-lookup                 Install a manual entity-lookup row (kind, canonical, value)
  teach-pattern                Install a manual generalization pattern (query_template, resource_template, entity_kind)
  teach-playbook               Record a CLI playbook + free-text notes for a query family
  tools                        List every Pin Generator MCP tool this CLI exposes, with credit costs (offline, free).
  unpinned-posts               List sitemap posts that have no scheduled pin and no ledgered spend.
  update-design-profile        Refine a design profile's colors, mood, style or description.
  version                      Print version
  which                        Find the command that implements a capability

Flags:
      --agent                    Set agent-friendly output defaults (--json --compact --no-input --no-color)
      --audit-dir string         Aggregate the receipt and index under this audit directory
      --ca-cert string           PEM CA bundle added to the system trust roots
      --client-profile string    Select the tenant-gated client profile (env: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE)
      --compact                  Return only key fields (id, name, status, timestamps) for minimal token usage
      --config string            Config file path
      --csv                      Output as CSV (table and array responses)
      --deliver string           Route output to a sink: stdout (default), file:<path>, webhook:<url>
      --dry-run                  Show request without sending
  -h, --help                     help for pingenerator-pp-cli
      --home string              Root directory for config, data, state, and cache files
      --human-friendly           Enable colored output and rich formatting
      --idempotent               Treat already-existing create results as a successful no-op
      --json                     Output as JSON
      --no-cache                 Bypass response cache
      --no-color                 Disable colored output
      --no-input                 Disable all interactive prompts (for CI/agents)
      --no-learn                 Disable the teach/recall learning loop for this invocation
      --plain                    Output as plain tab-separated text
      --profile string           Apply values from a saved run profile; this does not select a client (see 'pingenerator-pp-cli profile list')
      --quiet                    Bare output, one value per line
      --rate-limit float         Max requests per second (0 to disable; default auto — pace to server rate-limit headers) (default auto)
      --receipt                  Write an atomic private run receipt
      --receipt-file string      Override the run receipt destination
      --select string            Comma-separated fields to include in output
      --timeout duration         Request timeout (default 1m0s)
      --tls-server-name string   DNS name to verify when the dialed host does not match the certificate
  -v, --version                  version for pingenerator-pp-cli
      --yes                      Skip confirmation prompts (explicit confirmation for scripts)

Use "pingenerator-pp-cli [command] --help" for more information about a command.
